summary: This is GitHub issue #283 in the ros-planning/moveit2 repository, titled 'Use new ros2_control interfaces', opened by ShotaAk on Sep 17, 2020. The MoveIt 2 source build failed on Foxy because the fake_joint_driver included hardware_interface/joint_command_handle.hpp, a header removed from ros2_control by PR #134. The discussion covers pinning ros2_control commits as a workaround, the planned API stabilization for Foxy, and migration documentation, and the issue was closed as completed when PR #361 was merged on March 25, 2021.
one_line: GitHub issue tracking MoveIt 2 source build failure caused by removed ros2_control joint handle headers, closed by PR #361.
key_facts: GitHub issue #283 in the ros-planning/moveit2 repository was titled 'Use new ros2_control interfaces' and was opened by ShotaAk on Sep 17, 2020.
The colcon build of MoveIt 2 failed with 'hardware_interface/joint_command_handle.hpp: No such file or directory' in fake_joint_driver.h.
The reporter used ROS Distro Foxy on Ubuntu 20.04 with a source build.
The missing file joint_command_handle.hpp was removed by ros-controls/ros2_control PR #134.
henningkayser responded that ros2_control had recent breaking changes and recommended fixing the commit hash in the repos file until a stable API exists.
ShotaAk reported that the demo worked after checking out ros2_control at commit 2c3aad1cb8ad4d23925bceeb5c26e22d6cf859ef and ros2_controllers at commit d52902538a970e792ecc604416e22ef90a57f29e.
destogl said on Sep 20, 2020 that ros2_control was breaking a lot and new interfaces would be fixed in about a month.
henningkayser created PR #284 on Sep 21, 2020 to temporarily freeze ros2_control branches in the workspace.
ShotaAk replaced old joint handles of fake_joint_driver with new joint handles in a commit on Sep 25, 2020 and opened JafarAbdi/fake_joint PR #4 'Use new joint handles'.
bmagyar said on Sep 26, 2020 that upcoming ros2_control changes might break API/ABI multiple times, so a fixed version was recommended.
destogl announced on Dec 12, 2020 that the ros2_control API had been fixed for Foxy.
On Jan 5, 2021 destogl published short documentation in ros-controls/roadmap PR #36 including 'Differences to ros_control (ROS1)' and 'Migration Guide to ros2_control'.
The issue was closed as completed by henningkayser on Mar 25, 2021 after PR #361 'Use fake_components::GenericSystem from ros2_control' was merged.
The issue was assigned to JafarAbdi and labeled bug, with 245 open issues at the time the page was captured.
